scope: Post-hoc audit of all five consistently helped targets and the five largest mean losses among consistently harmed targets, over three 4000-token development runs.
limitations: No-example responses are separate conversations, not the agent’s recorded pre-evidence beliefs.
Actions, observations, and final probabilities do not establish the causal reason for a model decision.
Reference averaging is an untuned descriptive diagnostic, not a new official score or a measure of semantic relevance.
Target labels are used only in this offline audit and never supplied as new model evidence.
